# Is your boarding barn making money? Monthly profit, break-even occupancy and the board price you need

> Free profit calculator for horse boarding barns: stalls, occupancy, board price, feed, bedding, your own care time and fixed costs become monthly profit, break-even occupancy and the board price you need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
